inlines.v: DISCLOSURE, noun Disclozhur. 1. The act of disclosing; an uncovering and opening to view; discovery. 2. The act of revealing; utterance of what was secret; a telling. 3. The act of making known what was concealed. 4. That which is disclosed or made known.
